actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger every 2 days
Water slowly until it drains when top inch is dry, empty saucer after 15 minutes
Move plant at least 3 ft from heater vent or radiator
Run humidifier near plant daily if the white device is a humidifier
Otherwise set pot on pebble tray with water
Cut off fully yellow or crispy leaves at the stem base

reason: The answer identifies dehydration as the main cause and leads with proper watering, which matches the confirmed fix; the extra steps are sensible and not harmful.
